issues.explanation: Public input properties have no #[Validate] attribute and validation is inline only, deviating from the required #[Validate] + validate() pattern.
Public input properties have no #[Validate] attribute and validation is inline only, deviating from the required #[Validate] + validate() pattern.
Password reset update validates three fields inline with $request->validate instead of a Form Request once beyond one or two fields.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:254-270 and app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:343-364 use $this->validate([...]) with no #[Validate] attribute, vs conventions.md requiring #[Validate] + $this->validate(); redirects all use route() e.g. redirect()->route('login'), views use route() and plain wire:model="email"

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:109-114, app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:294-312 small focused methods with PHPDoc; consistent naming and no dead code

requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:976-1006 route names/methods match contract; app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:274-288 auth.failed on email, 5-try throttle, regenerate, redirectIntended home; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:360-374 strict+unique email, confirmed, Password::defaults(), Registered, login, regenerate; app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetController.php:207-229 rotates remember_token Str::random(60), fires PasswordReset, redirects login; lang/en/ui.php and lang/pt_BR/ui.php with same keys

scope.evidence: diff only adds auth routes/controllers/components/views/lang/config locale pins/phpunit locale pins/tests plus CHANGELOG entry; no mail theme, nginx/Docker, SCSS/JS, or entity/role changes

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:267-306 strict email:rfc,strict, auth.failed, throttleKey Str::lower+IP, auth.throttle, Lockout event; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:382-390 IP throttle key str()->transliterate('register|'.ip); VerifyEmailController uses EmailVerificationRequest (403 on tampered id); Blade uses {{ }} throughout

simplicity.evidence: reuses Password::broker()->sendResetLink/reset, EmailVerificationRequest, RateLimiter, Password::defaults() in AppServiceProvider.php:439; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Auth/LoginTest.php, RegisterTest.php, PasswordResetTest.php, EmailVerificationTest.php, HomeAndLogoutTest.php, LocalizationTest.php cover happy paths, strict/unique/confirmed/default-rule failures, lockout 5 tries, throttle 6/min 429, tampered-id 403, remember_token rotation, pt_BR/en strings

review.summary: Adds full session auth (Livewire login/register, logout, forgot/reset password, email verification) with pt-BR default locale and Bulma layouts, matching the route/view/config contract. Thorough Pest coverage and no security flaws found, but Livewire inputs miss the required #[Validate] attribute, so approve with nits.
